title: 'OUR PRICES HAVE NEVER BEEN LOWER!' - The Office US

lines.en: Here's what's going to happen. I am going to have to fix you.
lines.ko: 앞으로 이렇게 할 거야. 내가 너희를 고쳐 놔야겠어.

lines.en: Manage you two, on a more personal
lines.ko: 너희 둘을 좀 더 개인적인 수준에서 관리할 거야.

lines.en: scale. A more micro form of management. Jim, what is that called?
lines.ko: 더 작은 단위의 관리지. 짐, 그걸 뭐라고 하지?

lines.en: Now Jim is going to be the client.
Dwight, you're going to have to sell to him without being aggressive, hostile or difficult. Let's go.
lines.ko: 드와이트, 공격적이거나 적대적이거나 까다롭게 굴지 말고 짐한테 팔아 봐. 시작.

lines.en: Hello, this is Dwight Schrute from the Dunder Mifflin paper company.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 던더 미플린 제지회사의 드와이트 슈루트입니다.

lines.en: Well that's great, because I need paper.
Excellent, then you are in luck because we are having a limited time offer, only on EVERYTHING.
lines.ko: 잘됐네요. 지금 한정 특가 중인데, 전 품목이 대상입니다.

lines.en: Wow, this is my lucky day!
My family built this country by the way,
lines.ko: 참고로 우리 집안이 이 나라를 세웠어요.

lines.en: Could you hold on one second, it's my other line.
lines.ko: 잠깐만 기다려 주실래요? 다른 전화가 와서요.

lines.en: *Laughs* No, I'm just on the phone with this STUPID salesman. He's so dumb.
lines.ko: *웃음* 아니, 지금 멍청한 영업사원이랑 통화 중이야. 진짜 멍청해.

lines.en: Probably just gonna keep him on the line forever and not buy anything.
lines.ko: 그냥 계속 붙잡아 두고 아무것도 안 살 거야.

lines.en: It's up to you to change his mind.
lines.ko: 저 사람 마음을 돌리는 건 네 몫이야.

lines.en: Sorry, that was a family emergency.
Oh, I'm sorry, Mr. Buttlicker! As I was saying: we are having a limited-
lines.ko: 아, 죄송합니다, 버틀리커 씨! 말씀드리던 대로 한정...

lines.en: Sorry could you speak up a little bit louder?
lines.ko: 죄송한데 좀 더 크게 말해 주실래요?

lines.en: It's hard if he's an old man.
Okay, as I was saying right now -
lines.ko: 네, 아까 말씀드린 대로 지금 바로...

lines.en: Okay. Our prices have never been lower -
Son, you have to talk louder!
BUTTLICKER! OUR PRICES HAVE NEVER BEEN LOWER!
lines.ko: 버틀리커 씨! 저희 가격이 역대 최저입니다!

lines.en: You never yell at the client!
Now you listen to me, sir.
The three words I would describe you as, is aggressive, hostile and definitely difficult!
lines.ko: 제가 보기에 당신은 공격적이고 적대적이고 확실히 까다로운 사람입니다!

lines.en: Please give me another chance. Mr Buttlicker?
lines.ko: 한 번만 더 기회를 주세요. 버틀리커 씨?

lines.en: I have to put you on with my boss.
Hello. This is Michael Scott, regional manager.
Well, this is William M. Buttlicker.
Hello, Mr. Buttlicker. How may we help you?
Michael, I like the sound of your voice. You know what I'm gonna do? I'm gonna buy 1 million dollars worth of paper products today.
lines.ko: 마이클, 목소리가 마음에 드는군요. 이렇게 합시다. 오늘 종이 제품 100만 달러어치 사겠습니다.

lines.en: See how it's done? Thank you very much, sir. I don't think you'll regret it. See what I did?
lines.ko: 어떻게 하는지 보이지? 정말 감사합니다, 선생님. 후회하지 않으실 겁니다. 내가 한 거 봤지?

lines.en: You have to fire the salesman that treated me so terribly.
lines.ko: 날 그렇게 형편없이 대한 그 영업사원을 해고하세요.
